summary: Baseline still collecting after two substantial sessions. Communication can be sustained on familiar and semi-familiar topics, with promising repair and clarification behavior. Fluency and grammatical control remain variable under real-time pressure, especially during lexical search and longer spontaneous turns.

range.note: Can discuss familiar interests, hypothetical situations, travel problems and interpersonal boundaries; broader sampling is still needed.

accuracy.note: Meaning is usually recoverable, but agreement, prepositions and sentence assembly become unstable under time pressure.

fluency.note: Can sustain extended turns, but frequent restarts, fillers and word-by-word construction remain visible.

interaction.note: Regularly asks for clarification, redirects topics when needed and keeps conversational intent clear.

coherence.note: Longer opinions are understandable, though organization can loosen when searching for language.

active_vocabulary.note: Useful vocabulary is available in familiar domains; lexical retrieval gaps frequently trigger circumlocution.

repair_ability.note: Promising candidate strength: often reformulates, asks for the missing word, or explains around a lexical gap.

spontaneous_complexity.note: Can express nuanced reasoning about enjoyment, progress, social boundaries and reinforcement, but with substantial formulation effort.

strengths.label: Keeps communication going by reformulating, clarifying and describing around missing words.
Actively signals misunderstanding and redirects the conversation when a topic or question is not working.

recurring_weaknesses.pattern: Frequent restart chains and fillers while assembling spontaneous sentences.
recurring_weaknesses.note: Observed across both substantial sessions; slowing down slightly is the current strategy.

recurring_weaknesses.pattern: Lexical retrieval gaps lead to Spanish-influenced forms or repeated circumlocution.
Third-person singular agreement becomes unstable during longer spontaneous speech.
recurring_weaknesses.note: Strong within-session recurrence on 2026-10-06; needs confirmation in a fresh context before becoming a durable weakness.

vocabulary.meaning: retroceder / tomar distancia en una interacción

current_priorities: Reduce restart chains by speaking slightly more slowly and finishing the current sentence before reformulating.
Stabilize third-person singular agreement during spontaneous speech.
Build high-frequency natural chunks for situations where Spanish-influenced wording causes lexical blocks.

quests.title: Steady one-minute answer
quests.description: Give a fresh one-minute answer at a controlled pace, prioritizing continuity over Spanish-like speed.

quests.title: Third-person control
quests.description: Tell or explain something about another person in a fresh context while keeping he/she agreement stable.

evidence_notes: Two substantial naturalistic baseline sessions completed: 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-06.
No working CEFR assigned yet; evidence breadth remains insufficient.
Pronunciation/intelligibility remains unscored in durable state because transcript-only evidence is insufficient.
